threads.body:
[Testing] @copilot Please simplify `GraphqlErrorRecorderTest`. Remove the sampled/unsampled parameterization and custom sampler setup. We don't need defensive tests against a hypothetical `span.isRecording()` guard.

Replace the sampling/schema/message Cartesian product with a few focused tests for GraphQL-specific behavior. Avoid re-testing SDK behavior such as dropping null attribute values, and reuse the existing integration coverage instead of duplicating it here. Keep coverage for GraphQL error mapping, correct log context/scope, and exception-signal selection without multiplying unrelated cases. Do not change production behavior.

replies.body: Simplified the recorder test to one focused GraphQL error case, removed sampler and Cartesian-product coverage, and retained exact signal, context, and scope assertions across the existing default/logs/logs-dup tasks. Committed as `493edc95`.
